summary: Directed GraphMap self-loops have only an Outgoing adjacency entry, so filtering solely by direction incorrectly omits them from neighbors_directed(node, Incoming). The fix records the starting node and accepts neighbors matching either the requested direction or the starting node. Reversing the iterator filter restores the faulty behavior. The fix adds neighbors_incoming_includes_self_loops in tests/graphmap.rs, which expects Some(()) for the self-loop. No tests were executed.
